Question ID: CW_U06_L02_Q02

MLA Standard: MLA.CW.COM.03

Which sentence best revises "This story is about stuff that happened"?

answer.text: A. This story explores how a friendship changes when one character chooses honesty over comfort.

feedback.text: Correct. This states purpose clearly. This answer matches the lesson skill and is supported by the specific creative-writing evidence in the prompt.

answer.text: B. Stuff happened and it was stuff.

feedback.text: Incorrect. This remains vague. This choice is not supported by the provided context or lesson skill; choose the option grounded in the prompt.

feedback.text: Incorrect. This lacks purpose. This choice is not supported by the provided context or lesson skill; choose the option grounded in the prompt.
Incorrect. This is dismissive. This choice is not supported by the provided context or lesson skill; choose the option grounded in the prompt.

Question ID: CW_U06_L02_Q03

MLA Standard: MLA.CW.COM.03

Which author statement order is strongest?

answer.text: A. Complaint, apology, random detail, file name.

feedback.text: Incorrect. This is not a useful author statement.

answer.text: B. Purpose, craft choices, revision or growth, reader effect.

feedback.text: Correct. This order organizes craft reasoning. This answer matches the lesson skill and is supported by the specific creative-writing evidence in the prompt.
Incorrect. Summary alone is insufficient. This choice is not supported by the provided context or lesson skill; choose the option grounded in the prompt.

answer.text: D. Font, date, file size, page count.

feedback.text: Incorrect. These do not explain craft. This choice is not supported by the provided context or lesson skill; choose the option grounded in the prompt.

Question ID: CW_U06_L02_Q04

MLA Standard: MLA.CW.COM.03

Which sentence sounds defensive?

answer.text: A. I used repeated imagery to slow the reader down.

feedback.text: Incorrect. This is craft-focused. This choice is not supported by the provided context or lesson skill; choose the option grounded in the prompt.

answer.text: B. I revised the ending after feedback.

feedback.text: Incorrect. This is reflective. This choice is not supported by the provided context or lesson skill; choose the option grounded in the prompt.

answer.text: C. The final image is meant to feel unresolved.

feedback.text: Incorrect. This explains intent. This choice is not supported by the provided context or lesson skill; choose the option grounded in the prompt.

answer.text: D. If readers do not understand it, that is their problem.

feedback.text: Correct. This rejects reader understanding instead of explaining craft.

MLA Standard: MLA.CW.COM.03

Which sentence best communicates craft reasoning?

answer.text: A. I used short lines so the final image would feel quiet and delayed.

feedback.text: Correct. This names a choice and effect. This answer matches the lesson skill and is supported by the specific creative-writing evidence in the prompt.
Incorrect. This is vague praise. This choice is not supported by the provided context or lesson skill; choose the option grounded in the prompt.

Incorrect. This is defensive. This choice is not supported by the provided context or lesson skill; choose the option grounded in the prompt.

MLA Standard: MLA.CW.COM.03

A statement says, "I just wrote this and it came out pretty good." What revision is best?

answer.text: A. I wrote this and it is perfect.
